svg.title: The jobs of a pull request
svg.desc: Each job of a push waits for a runner of its own, and the account runs about 20 jobs at once. So the quick checks share their jobs: lint runs every linter, the title job checks the title and the entry in the changelog, codeql analyzes every language under the category of its alerts, and home-assistant runs HACS and hassfest. Each step runs also when one before it failed, and the PR coach explains each check of a job that failed.
